itemdesc-shapingtool: A chisel with an Unaligned crystal set in its handle. It commands stone.
shapingtool-charge-3: All three glyphs are lit: full.
shapingtool-draw: Draw charge from a charged crystal or sparkstone
shapingtool-awaken: Hold on polished rock to awaken it
blockdesc-sparkstone-awakened-*: Polished stone carved with glyphs. It stores charge and shares it with every block of it that it touches.
